other_conditions: The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan.
The child must be enrolled in an Anganwadi or school if aged between 2 and 5 years.
Children above the age of 6 must be studying in a recognized educational institution.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹500 per month for children aged 0-6 and ₹1,000 per month for children aged 6-18.
